verdict.rationale: Extend offers a documented CLI, Python SDK (pip install), and REST API with sync/async modes and a test API key mode, all of which support headless/CI-driven automation of document processing. However, there is no explicit CI/CD integration guide, GitHub Actions example, or independent hands-on report of running it in a CI pipeline. missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline examples/integration guide, independent hands-on verification of headless CI usage, and details on exit codes/CLI scripting ergonomics for automation.
